procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the six pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_90 (banner '2026 General Election' on the table pages -- cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/tallahatchie/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (10/10 on the Senate/House/CoA table pairs, 6/6 on the Chancery/Circuit pairs).
structure_note: Six-page shape: p1 a FAX TRANSMISSION REPORT page (Tall. Co. Circuit fax to SoS 11/13/2026 09:28, 'FAX TX REPORT OK' over PGS. 5) scanned ahead of the recap, and p2 the certification/signature page -- both local-only; p3+p4 = the countywide ballot's first table half over the county's NINETEEN precincts (printed Page 2: 11 columns Blue Cane..Rosebloom; printed Page 3: the remaining 8 columns Springhill..Webb Beat #5 + TOTAL) carrying Senate, House 2, CoA 1 Positions 1-2, and CoA 2 Position 1; p5+p6 = the second table half over the same column split (printed Pages 4-5) carrying Chancery 3 Places 1-3, Circuit 17 Places 1-2, and two local school sections. The section headers print on every table page they span (Chancery 3 Place 1's header closes printed Pages 2 AND 3; its rows open printed Page 4). The banner prints '2026 General Election'. Races: U.S. Senate (Colom/Hyde-Smith/Pinkins, ballot order DEM-REP-IND); US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District (Ron Eller REP first, then Bennie G. Thompson DEM, then Bennie Foster IND -- the House 2 roster, names identical, ballot order Republican-first as Yalobusha prints); Court Of Appeals 01-District 1 Position 1 (Derek Dewayne Hopson Jr., John Weddle) and Position 2 (Donna M. Barnes) -- the same CoA 1 roster, names identical; Court Of Appeals 02-District 2 Position 1 (Deborah A. McDonald -- the CoA 2 roster alone, names identical, TWENTIETH county); Chancery Court 3-Chancery District 3 Place 1 (Ginger M. Miller, Jay Westfaul), Place 2 (Sabrina D. Howell), Place 3 (Mitchell M. Lundy Jr.) -- the FULL Chancery 3 roster, names identical (NINTH county); Circuit Court 17-Circuit District 17 Place 1 (Smith Murphey V) and Place 2 (James 'Jimmy' McClure) -- identical, now FOUR counties (Tate/Panola/Yalobusha/Tallahatchie). Printed totals: Colom 2808, Hyde-Smith 1510, Pinkins 65, Eller 1479, Thompson 2833, Foster 65, Hopson 1495, Weddle 899, Barnes 2156, McDonald 910, Miller 2249, Westfaul 1403, Howell 3079, Lundy 3108, Murphey 3137, McClure 2990.
operator_rows_note: All 16 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; first-half rows carry p3+p4 cells + the p4 printed TOTAL, second-half rows carry p5+p6 cells + the p6 printed TOTAL. Tallahatchie STRADDLES Court of Appeals districts: CoA 1's rows X-cell Glendora and Phillip on printed Page 2 and Sumner Beat #2, Sumner Beat #5, Tutwiler, Webb Beat #4 and Webb Beat #5 on printed Page 3 (the seven CoA-2 precincts), and CoA 2's row X-cells the other twelve -- each X fills 0 under its row's own printed TOTAL.
truncation_note: No truncations; the nineteen precinct headers print complete (Blue Cane, Cascilla, Charleston Beat #1, Charleston Beat #2, Charleston Beat #3, Enid, Glendora, Murphreesboro, Paynes, Phillip, Rosebloom, Springhill, Sumner Beat #2, Sumner Beat #5, Teasdale, Tippo, Tutwiler, Webb Beat #4, Webb Beat #5 -- the sheet's own numbered-beat forms kept verbatim, including its 'Murphreesboro' spelling).
local_note: p5/p6 carry two local sections after Circuit 17 Place 2: 'School District 1-Education District 1' (Lucinda Berryhill, X-celled everywhere on printed Page 4 with her 143 at Tutwiler on Page 5) and 'School District 6-Education District 6' (Audra Brown, Daniel A. Tenner, values only at the Charleston beats) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows. CoA 2's printed Places are Position 1 only (matching the other CoA 2 counties); Chancery 3's printed Places are 1, 2 and 3; Circuit 17's printed Places are 1 and 2.
